remarks:
Welcome to this gorgeous, completely updated West Seneca condo, nestled in a cozy and quiet community! Move-in ready and packed with upgrades, this home is ready for its next owner.

The beautifully updated kitchen features stunning quartz countertops, luxury vinyl flooring, and high-end appliances. The spacious living room offers a built-in fireplace, while the covered patio provides a great place to relax and enjoy the outdoors.

Both bedrooms are generously sized, including a huge primary bedroom with an impressive walk-in closet. Both bathrooms have been tastefully updated, and modern lighting can be found throughout the home. You'll also love the large pantry, convenient in-unit laundry, and abundant storage space—including a huge, dry basement for even more room.

Additional updates include a new furnace and water tank. Enjoy the convenience of two parking spaces and a fantastic location close to major interstates and key shopping centers.

Don't miss your opportunity to make this beautiful condo your new home!  Open house Saturday 9/5 from 11 to 1.
